body: Done (frontend) — #1534 (merged) retires sys_view/sys_report/sys_dashboard from the frontend: flag + all legacy write/read/fallback paths + toSysViewPayload/fromSysViewRecord removed; runtime editing is metadata-only. System pre-launch → no data migration. Remaining: dropping the physical object schemas + CRUD endpoints is a separate framework-repo task (frontend no longer references them, so the tables are dead).
